statements.JinWishart.determinantEnsemble_total_mas: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j,Integrable (fun y => f i y*g j y) μ) (hpos : ∀ z,0≤determinantProduct f g z) : determinantEnsembleMeasure μ f g Set.univ= ENNReal.ofReal ((n.factorial : ℝ)*(determinantMomentMatrix μ f g).det)
statements.JinWishart.determinantEnsemble_count_mas: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j,Integrable (fun y => f i y*g j y) μ) (hpos : ∀ z,0≤determinantProduct f g z) (E : Set ℝ) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (k : ℕ) (hk : k≤n) : determinantEnsembleMeasure μ f g {z | coordinateMembershipCount E z=k}= ENNReal.ofReal ((n.factorial : ℝ)* ((rowAffinePolynomialMatrix (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in E,f i y*g j y ∂μ)) (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in Eᶜ,f i y*g j y ∂μ))).det).coeff k)
statements.JinWishart.normalizedDeterminantEnsemble: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j,Integrable (fun y => f i y*g j y) μ) (hpos : ∀ z,0≤determinantProduct f g z) (hdet : 0<(determinantMomentMatrix μ f g).det) : IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedDeterminantEnsemble μ f g) ∧ ∀ (E : Set ℝ),MeasurableSet E → ∀ (k : ℕ),k≤n → ((normalizedDeterminantEnsemble μ f g) {z | coordinateMembershipCount E z=k}).toReal= ((rowAffinePolynomialMatrix (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in E,f i y*g j y ∂μ)) (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y in Eᶜ,f i y*g j y ∂μ))).det).coeff k/ (determinantMomentMatrix μ f g).det
